text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"‘Every day is so fulfilling! Trainer's 
instructions are so thorough and easy to 
understand, so training is—’"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh, Trainer...? Wait, GAAH!? Training 
time is already past...!?”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm sorry! I was writing a letter to 
my big sister and got totally absorbed in 
it...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry! I'll be right there! 
Right away! To apologize in person...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight seems deeply remorseful. I 
tell her to calm down and caution her to 
be more careful in the future.
